title: AcDs-history DWG frame adapter capture bounds
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Bound dx_iface retention of opaque DWG frame companions used for EvaluationGraph/AcSh-history correlation.
Preserve opaque callback/retained-frame accounting and refuse export if a selected frame cannot be retained.
Add generated tests without an external or persistent drawing fixture.

behavior: Retains only the prior evaluation-graph and AcSh history record/class names in acdsHistoryDwgFrames; entity and unrelated unsupported callbacks are not copied there.
Estimates fixed frame storage, reactor-handle slots, record/class/application strings, and raw body bytes before copy.
Enforces 100000 retained records and DRW::kMaxDxfBinaryPayloadBytes total logical bytes; allocation, record-limit, and byte-limit failures are sticky.
Counts retained opaque frames only after successful vector insertion and makes strict DWG completeness/export preflight fail closed on capture failure.
Opaque frames remain correlation/diagnostic data and are not treated as DXF serializer input.
implementation.compatibility: No public API or model layout changed in this slice; the previously declared dx_iface override is now defined. No ACIS, AcDs layout, or native-consumer support claim is made.

commands: git diff --check -- dwg2dxf/dx_data.h dwg2dxf/dx_iface.h dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp tests/CMakeLists.txt
testCoverage: normal generated AcSh history raw-frame retention and exact logical-byte accounting
opaque callback and successfully retained frame counters
entity and unrelated unsupported-record exclusion from the frame copy

assessment.nextSlice: Continue the 7S.2c retained-output/callback-copy census with dx_iface::addRawDxfEntity; ordered raw-record event copies are currently guarded for missing block ownership but lack aggregate record/byte admission.
